item.title: PLA26210 Conservation Skills Torbay
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-14T12:00:00+00:00
Torbay Council are seeking bids from appropriate skills learning providers to offer introductory conservation skills sessions to enhance learning for students/apprentices who are already engaged in formal Further Education. The Provider must be a Further Education Provider delivering the following courses within the Torbay area: • Bricklaying • Carpentry/joinery • Painting and decorating • Plastering The award of this Contract is conditional upon the Authority securing grant funding for the delivery of the project.
